GENERAL SCIENCE — MOCK EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Evolution and Biodiversity? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Evolution and Biodiversity.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Evolution and Biodiversity.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Evolution and Biodiversity.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Evolution and Biodiversity.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.

   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

5. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Producers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

6. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Removing all vegetation

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o.

8. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water always increases oxygen

9. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
   D. watt (W)

10. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrostatics? (1 mark)

13. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 37 °C

14. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Milk souring
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

15. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane
